responsibilities: Build and maintain trusted GTM data models in Snowflake that support reporting across Sales, CS, Finance, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations.
Consolidate Salesforce and other GTM system data into a single, reportable source of truth.
Create governed datasets for pipeline, bookings, forecast, renewals, expansion, churn, hierarchy, product, territory, and sales performance reporting.
Define transformation logic, business rules, joins, filters, exclusions, and documentation needed to make data usable and repeatable.
Reconcile Salesforce and Snowflake data so core revenue metrics match across systems.
Investigate differences between Salesforce reports, Snowflake tables, BI dashboards, and Finance reporting.
Identify whether discrepancies stem from source-system issues, integration failures, transformation logic, timing differences, field mapping, hierarchy logic, or reporting filters.
Build QA checks and reconciliation processes that proactively flag mismatches before they reach leadership reporting.
Lead data cleanup and standardization across GTM systems and reporting layers.
Identify duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent, stale, or misclassified revenue data.
Create repeatable rules for data normalization, account hierarchy, territory assignment, product mapping, opportunity classification, renewal logic, and lifecycle status.
Maintain mapping tables, data dictionaries, metric definitions, lineage documentation, and QA logic.
Consolidate data from Salesforce and GTM sources such as marketing automation, customer success, sales engagement, forecasting, product usage, enrichment, quote/order, or finance platforms.
Understand ingestion pipelines, sync timing, API limitations, and transformation dependencies in partnership with technical teams.
Turn raw and inconsistent source data into reliable analytical datasets with clear lineage from source systems to final reporting tables.
Reduce manual pulls, spreadsheet workarounds, and conflicting reports by improving the trusted data foundation.
Build datasets, semantic layers, and curated views that allow analysts and business users to create trusted dashboards.
Validate that reporting outputs match approved source-of-truth logic before dashboards are published.
Use AI tools to accelerate SQL development, QA checks, documentation, anomaly detection, data mapping, and automation.
Support U.S.-based stakeholders during U.S. business hours and translate technical data issues into clear business language.
Proactively flag risks, gaps, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs before they impact reporting.
